sn3.3:1.2: nisinno kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn3.3:1.3: Atthi nu kho bhante jātassa aññatra jarāmaraṇā ti || || 3.
sn3.3:1.5: Ye pi te mahārāja khattiya-mahāsalā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūta-jātarūparajatā pahūta-vittūpakaraṇā pahūta-dhanadhaññā || tesam pi jātānaṃ natthi aññatra jarāmaraṇā || || 5.
sn3.3:1.7: gahapati-mahāsālā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūta-jātarūparajatā pahūta-vittūpakaraṇā pahūta-dhanadhaññā || tesam pi jātānaṃ natthi aññatra jarāmaraṇā || 6.
sn3.3:1.8: Ye pi te mahārāja bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto kata-karaṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīna-bhava-saṃyojanā sammadaññā vimuttā || tesaṃ pāyaṃ kāyo bhedana-dhammo nikkhepana-dhammo ti || || 7.
sn3.3:2.3: satañ ca dhammo na jaram upeti ||
sn3.3:2.4: santo have sabbhi pavedayantīti || || 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ || || 2. Ekam antaṃ
